actions.addCustomer.description: Add a new customer to your Cryptolens account
actions.addCustomer.props.allowActivatio: If enabled, the customer can activate and deactivate devices through the customer portal
actions.addCustomer.props.allowMultipleU: If enabled, multiple user accounts can be associated with this customer
actions.addCustomer.props.companyName.de: The company name the customer belongs to (max 100 characters)
actions.addCustomer.props.email.descript: The email of the customer (max 100 characters)
actions.addCustomer.props.enableCustomer: If enabled, a portal link will be returned where the customer can view their licenses
actions.addCustomer.props.name.descripti: The name of the customer (max 100 characters)
actions.blockKey.description: Block a license key to prevent it from being accessible by most Web API methods
actions.blockKey.props.key.description: The serial key string to block
actions.createKey.description: Create a new license key for a product
A list of machine codes (separated by new lines) that will be prioritized during activation
actions.createKey.props.block.descriptio: Block the key from being accessed by the Activation method
actions.createKey.props.customerId.descr: The ID of the customer to associate with this license key
The maximum number of computers that can activate the key. Default is 0 (unlimited).
actions.createKey.props.noOfKeys.descrip: The number of keys to generate. Default is 1. Maximum 1000 per request.
actions.createKey.props.notes.descriptio: Additional notes about the license key (max 500 characters)
actions.createKey.props.period.descripti: The number of days from today the license key should be valid. Default is 0 (no expiration).
actions.createKey.props.resellerId.descr: The ID of the reseller to associate with this license key
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.extendLicense.description: Extend a license key by a specified number of days
actions.extendLicense.props.key.descript: The serial key string to extend
actions.extendLicense.props.noOfDays.des: The number of days to extend the license. Use negative numbers to decrease the expiration date.
auth.description: Your Cryptolens access token. Get it from https://app.cryptolens.io/User/AccessToken
description: Cryptolens is a Software Licensing as a Service (SLaaS) platform that provides developers with tools to manage software licenses, protect against piracy, and analyze usage data.
triggers.newApiEvent.description: Trigger when a new API event is logged (activation, deactivation, key creation, etc.)
triggers.newApiEvent.props.key.descripti: Filter events for a specific license key (requires Product ID)
triggers.newApiEvent.props.limit.descrip: Maximum number of events to fetch per poll (default 100, max 1000)
triggers.newApiEvent.props.productId.des: Filter events for a specific product (optional)
triggers.newApiEvent.props.states.descri: Filter by event states (comma-separated numbers). E.g., 1010 for validation, 2010 for activation, 3010 for key creation, 6010 for deactivation
